description: One x402 seller's measured revenue and buyers, by host (blockrun.ai) or payTo address: the latest day's revenue, payments, unique and repeat payers, top payer share and wash flags, its 7-day totals, and up to 90 days of daily history. Measured from USDC transfers of $5 or less into each seller's payTo on Base, one UTC day at a time, with the day it covers. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

host.description: Seller hostname, e.g. blockrun.ai (or pass payTo)

payTo.description: Seller's payTo address on Base (or pass host)

name: x402_seller_stats
